name: Business Document Form
summary: Create or edit one business document with meaningful grouping, recovery, validation, and a clear completion action.

useWhen: creating or editing one business document

content.task: Create or edit one business document and commit the intended change.

requiredRegions.responsibility: Identify the document, mode, and consequential state.
Collect business information in understandable groups or stages.
Expose recovery and the action that completes the current intent.

optionalRegions.responsibility: Edit repeatable business line items when the document requires them.
Navigate a long continuous form without turning it into false stages.

forbiddenCombinations: Materialize both single-page and wizard Templates into the same form
